meta.title: Pre-qualification questionnaire — Permis-Exchange
meta.description: Answer a few questions about your foreign licence and your residency in Italy to find out if you're eligible for conversion.

licence.country: Which country issued your current licence?

residency.since: Since when have you been in Italy?

history.timingQuestion: Did you get your current licence before or after becoming a resident in Italy?
history.obtainedByExchange: Was your current licence obtained through a licence exchange (rather than the standard exam)?
history.previousAttempt: Have you already tried to convert your foreign licence to an Italian one?
history.previousResult: What was the outcome of that attempt?

contact.phoneHint: Ideally a number reachable on WhatsApp.

confirmation.title: Thank you, your questionnaire was received
confirmation.subtitle: Our team is reviewing your answers and will contact you by email or WhatsApp within 48 business hours to confirm your eligibility and the next steps.
